capabilities: Zoom into the heading or list item at the cursor, hiding everything else
Show a breadcrumb bar to jump to any zoom level or the whole note
Zoom straight into any heading via a picker command
Open links to headings or list items with the target zoomed in
Remember each tab's zoom across navigation and restarts
extras: The manifest carries the notice "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." The README warns to turn the old Zoom plugin off first, since two breadcrumb bars would otherwise show, and its hotkeys do not carry over.
intentEvidence: This plugin does what Zoom does and adds Zoom-out-one-level, clickable crumbs and the editor menu entry
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to focus on one section or list item while editing; folding requires fold settings and gives no breadcrumbs.

relations.evidence: This plugin does what Zoom does and adds Zoom-out-one-level, clickable crumbs

summary: Editor zoom that shows only the heading or list item at the cursor, with a breadcrumb bar to climb back out, without needing fold settings.
